title: Changelog
description: All notable changes to Zenith Companion will be documented in this file. Updates are organized chronologically by release date.

items.title: World Map Travel Cost & Territory Links
items.description: Added calibrated distance, teleport gold cost (with Banished and Cursed class discounts), and walk-time estimates from your active character's location directly in World Map, alongside live Conquest control bars, house-location badges, Weather Guide links, and Lore links.
items.raw: - **World Map Travel Cost & Territory Links**: Added calibrated distance, teleport gold cost (with Banished and Cursed class discounts), and walk-time estimates from your active character's location directly in World Map, alongside live Conquest control bars, house-location badges, Weather Guide links, and Lore links.

items.title: Conquest Season Archive
items.description: You can now browse past conquest seasons (**Season 3** through **Season 12**) alongside the current season in Conquest, complete with zone winners, paginated contributor rankings, and historical control shares.
items.raw: - **Conquest Season Archive**: You can now browse past conquest seasons (**Season 3** through **Season 12**) alongside the current season in Conquest, complete with zone winners, paginated contributor rankings, and historical control shares.

items.title: Conquest Buffs, Shards & Live Assault Timers
items.description: Conquest now shows live assault wave countdowns, resolves each top contributor's guild badge, displays guild levels, and provides a top-level **Buffs & Shards** guide for Territory Ruling Buffs (Ranks 1–10) and Zone Shard payouts (Ranks 1–25).
items.raw: - **Conquest Buffs, Shards & Live Assault Timers**: Conquest now shows live assault wave countdowns, resolves each top contributor's guild badge, displays guild levels, and provides a top-level **Buffs & Shards** guide for Territory Ruling Buffs (Ranks 1–10) and Zone Shard payouts (Ranks 1–25).

items.title: Equipped Pet Spotlight
items.description: Your currently equipped pet now sits pinned at the top of Owned Pets with Power, Health, Location, best Battle EV/hr, and 1-click catalog comparison.
items.raw: - **Equipped Pet Spotlight**: Your currently equipped pet now sits pinned at the top of Owned Pets with Power, Health, Location, best Battle EV/hr, and 1-click catalog comparison.

items.title: Missing Pets & Multi-Select Compare
items.description: Owned Pets now tracks your collection progress, adds a **Missing Pets** view with drop sources and exchange floor prices, adds a sortable **Table** view, and lets you select 2–4 pets to open together in Pet Comparison.
items.raw: - **Missing Pets & Multi-Select Compare**: Owned Pets now tracks your collection progress, adds a **Missing Pets** view with drop sources and exchange floor prices, adds a sortable **Table** view, and lets you select 2–4 pets to open together in Pet Comparison.

items.title: World Map Redesign
items.description: Rebuilt World Map in the Astral Slate design system with an expansive panoramic map backdrop, level-sorted region pickers, `From -> To` travel estimator, in-place **Enemy Details** modal (with clickable loot drops), structured per-skill weather modifiers, and a chronological **Weather Forecast** timeline with quick filters.
items.raw: - **World Map Redesign**: Rebuilt World Map in the Astral Slate design system with an expansive panoramic map backdrop, level-sorted region pickers, `From -> To` travel estimator, in-place **Enemy Details** modal (with clickable loot drops), structured per-skill weather modifiers, and a chronological **Weather Forecast** timeline with quick filters.

items.title: What's New Timeline Redesign
items.description: Upgraded What's New to a chronological release timeline with semantic date nodes, calm slate filter tabs, quick release jump counts, and smooth accordion drawers synced to the latest release date.
items.raw: - **What's New Timeline Redesign**: Upgraded What's New to a chronological release timeline with semantic date nodes, calm slate filter tabs, quick release jump counts, and smooth accordion drawers synced to the latest release date.

items.title: Museum Collection Redesign
items.description: Merged duplicate museum category filters into one toolbar, added a compact Snapshot Info modal, direct collectible inspection and Pet/Enemy Database links, paginated browsing (24, 48, or 96 entries per page), shareable filter links, and a floating Back to Top button.
items.raw: - **Museum Collection Redesign**: Merged duplicate museum category filters into one toolbar, added a compact Snapshot Info modal, direct collectible inspection and Pet/Enemy Database links, paginated browsing (24, 48, or 96 entries per page), shareable filter links, and a floating Back to Top button.

items.title: Calmer Dark-Mode Contrast
items.description: Toned down stark bright-white active tabs, filter pills, pagination buttons, and primary buttons to calmer slate tones so dark screens feel more relaxed on the eyes.
items.raw: - **Calmer Dark-Mode Contrast**: Toned down stark bright-white active tabs, filter pills, pagination buttons, and primary buttons to calmer slate tones so dark screens feel more relaxed on the eyes.

items.title: Conquest Redesign
items.description: Rebuilt Conquest in the monochromatic Astral Slate palette with clearly labeled control-share bars, inline vertical metric dividers, paginated contributor lists, world map deep links, shareable URL filters, and a floating Back to Top button.
items.raw: - **Conquest Redesign**: Rebuilt Conquest in the monochromatic Astral Slate palette with clearly labeled control-share bars, inline vertical metric dividers, paginated contributor lists, world map deep links, shareable URL filters, and a floating Back to Top button.

items.title: Smooth Back to Top
items.description: Standardized a single floating **Back to Top** button across Conquest, House Planner, Items Database, Enemy Database, Pet Database, Owned Pets, and What's New with smooth fade and slide transitions above the mobile dock.
items.raw: - **Smooth Back to Top**: Standardized a single floating **Back to Top** button across Conquest, House Planner, Items Database, Enemy Database, Pet Database, Owned Pets, and What's New with smooth fade and slide transitions above the mobile dock.

items.title: House Planner Redesign
items.description: Rebuilt House Planner with scoped styling, an inline profile/mode/cost summary strip, in-game gold and construction material icons, unified skill icons across all 5 tabs, and responsive mobile controls.
items.raw: - **House Planner Redesign**: Rebuilt House Planner with scoped styling, an inline profile/mode/cost summary strip, in-game gold and construction material icons, unified skill icons across all 5 tabs, and responsive mobile controls.

items.title: Pet Comparison Overhaul
items.description: Redesigned Pet Comparison with a collapsible shared setup panel, searchable pet picker modal, cleaner comparison cards, distinct stat icons across the metrics table, and shareable comparison links.
items.raw: - **Pet Comparison Overhaul**: Redesigned Pet Comparison with a collapsible shared setup panel, searchable pet picker modal, cleaner comparison cards, distinct stat icons across the metrics table, and shareable comparison links.

items.title: Owned Pets Redesign
items.description: Rebuilt Owned Pets with **Your Pets** and **Missing Pets** tabs, **Cards** and **Table** views, a full Pet Details modal, page navigation, and a floating back-to-top button.
items.raw: - **Owned Pets Redesign**: Rebuilt Owned Pets with **Your Pets** and **Missing Pets** tabs, **Cards** and **Table** views, a full Pet Details modal, page navigation, and a floating back-to-top button.

items.title: Pet Directory Redesign
items.description: Redesigned the companion catalog with responsive cards, clean stat comparisons, and direct egg acquisition links.
items.raw: - **Pet Directory Redesign**: Redesigned the companion catalog with responsive cards, clean stat comparisons, and direct egg acquisition links.

items.title: Pet Setup Simulator
items.description: Consolidated level, mastery, and evolution stat controls into a collapsible simulator panel with instant calculation updates.
items.raw: - **Pet Setup Simulator**: Consolidated level, mastery, and evolution stat controls into a collapsible simulator panel with instant calculation updates.

items.title: Bounded Page Navigation
items.description: Switched from infinite scrolling to fast page navigation (12, 24, or 48 companions per page) for smoother browsing.
items.raw: - **Bounded Page Navigation**: Switched from infinite scrolling to fast page navigation (12, 24, or 48 companions per page) for smoother browsing.

items.title: Mobile Sheet Ergonomics
items.description: Companion and combat details now open in an edge-to-edge mobile bottom sheet with swipe-to-dismiss and floating back-to-top button.
items.raw: - **Mobile Sheet Ergonomics**: Companion and combat details now open in an edge-to-edge mobile bottom sheet with swipe-to-dismiss and floating back-to-top button.

items.title: Alt Museum Live Import Sync
items.description: Redeployed the profile import worker so visible alt characters fetch their own museums directly instead of leaving alt museums empty on import.
items.raw: - **Alt Museum Live Import Sync**: Redeployed the profile import worker so visible alt characters fetch their own museums directly instead of leaving alt museums empty on import.

items.title: What's New Release Date Sync
items.description: Fixed the top summary tag displaying the previous date (`24 Nov 2026`) instead of matching the newest release (`25 Nov 2026`).
items.raw: - **What's New Release Date Sync**: Fixed the top summary tag displaying the previous date (`24 Nov 2026`) instead of matching the newest release (`25 Nov 2026`).

items.title: House Planner Readability & Currency Icons
items.description: Fixed smashed header/card labels on Profit, Built Components, and Guest Buffs tabs, aligned gold coin and material item icons cleanly beside values, and fixed condition readout ordering.
items.raw: - **House Planner Readability & Currency Icons**: Fixed smashed header/card labels on Profit, Built Components, and Guest Buffs tabs, aligned gold coin and material item icons cleanly beside values, and fixed condition readout ordering.

items.title: Pet Setup Controls
items.description: Fixed the +/- buttons on level, mastery, and evolution inputs, renamed "Beastmaster Context" to "Beastmaster Class", and stopped simulator dropdowns from clipping or sitting behind nearby fields.
items.raw: - **Pet Setup Controls**: Fixed the +/- buttons on level, mastery, and evolution inputs, renamed "Beastmaster Context" to "Beastmaster Class", and stopped simulator dropdowns from clipping or sitting behind nearby fields.

items.title: Pet Table & Modal Layout
items.description: Added spacing between pet icons and names in table view, stopped mobile table columns from squishing numbers, cleaned up duplicate card and modal borders, and centered page navigation controls.
items.raw: - **Pet Table & Modal Layout**: Added spacing between pet icons and names in table view, stopped mobile table columns from squishing numbers, cleaned up duplicate card and modal borders, and centered page navigation controls.
